notes: AudioRecorder: new Voice record format (mono 16-bit 16 kHz), for speech notes and speech-to-text. Files are about 4x smaller, so BLE download is much faster. Pick the mic's input channel in the inspector. WAV headers now match the audio actually written. MIDIOut: new All output (TRS + USB + BLE), BLE MIDI now carries CCs and clock/start/stop, and the channel is 1-16 to match the patcher. AudioRecorder hw_mask (rewired strip cables stop the native pot/button mapping) and GranularSynth PSRAM reserve. Includes all changes since 1.10.98.
